name: securacv_lowpower
description: SecuraCV Low-Power — thin HAL abstracting the ESP32-S3 native deep-sleep machinery (esp_sleep_*). Wake sources: timer, touch (RTC peripheral), EXT0 (single GPIO), EXT1 (multi GPIO), ULP-RISC-V. The rest of the firmware calls clean lowpower_arm_wake_*() / lowpower_enter_deep_sleep() / lowpower_get_wake_reason() — nothing in the application talks directly to esp_sleep_*.
